explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: Corvale East holds 479 units of esomeprazole sodium at 26.2 units per day, providing 18 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 1,045 units at 38.3 units per day, providing 27 days on hand.
One registered plant on our product labels, Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407), received an Official Action Indicated (OAI) classification on 2009-06-11.
A Warning Letter followed on 2010-04-08 citing the same facility.
Subsequent inspections of Bryant Ranch Prepack from 2010 through 2026-07-16 have all been classified Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI).
Other labeled plants — Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) and Hainan Poly Pharm. Co., Ltd. (FEI 3005115952) — show only VAI inspections through 2024-07-25 and 2023-06-30 respectively.

Q-40632b.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%omeprazole%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%omeprazole%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key
